name: Collin County, TX
findings: Collin County has 3,277 nonprofit organizations. 1,334 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,038 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Collin County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few research and think tank organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 4 research and think tank organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 28 would.

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through research and think tank groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Collin County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 72 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few economic development organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 6 economic development organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 20 would.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through economic development groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 228 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 228 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
